)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "permissionKey" text NOT NULL,
  "roleId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "scope" text DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "RolePermission_scope_check_4253cd73" CHECK ("scope" IN ('own', 'all'))
)

label: Copy each employee's role into EmployeeRole

precheck.description: ensure every employee role names an existing role
precheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."Employee" e
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."Role" r WHERE r."name" = e."role")
) AS "result"

execute.description: link each employee to the role named in Employee.role
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "public"."EmployeeRole" ("employeeId", "roleId")
SELECT e."id", r."id"
FROM "public"."Employee" e
JOIN "public"."Role" r ON r."name" = e."role"

postcheck.description: verify every employee now has a role
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."Employee" e
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."EmployeeRole" er WHERE er."employeeId" = e."id")
) AS "result"
